notes.title: Smile To Fly is out!
notes.content:
This day is a happy day - I am glad to present you Smile To Fly v1.0! 
I've made a big work last month fixing and improving the game features in the Early Access and now we are ready to be released!

So here is the short list of all changes comes into full version of the game.

Game:
[list]
[*] Implemented a tower defence system. Build and upgrade your weapon towers and survive waves to complete the game!
[*] UI redesigned, added goals panel and waves indicator. Also added a navigation panel to make camera movement even simpler.
[*] 10 new achievements connected with tower defence waves.
[*] Spies now appears rarely and only on the border of the colony (from the enemy side).
[*] Various small changes and improves.
[/list]

Bugfixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed issue with Cafe and Tea house after game loading.
[*] Fixed achievment bugs when resource-gain achievements sometimes were unavailable.
[*] Small UI bugfixes.
[*] Small text/translation improvments.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35894867/6134454db0cdc2db3f7f2b2d65de27912fc0d4e1.png[/img]

notes.title: The game release is coming soon!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Today I've got an excellent news - Smile To Fly is going to be released from the Early Access this week! 
The release will be supplied with huge update which will add a tower-defence elements with new buildings and new opportunities!
So these days is your last chance to get Smile To Fly with lower price, because soon the price will be raised up.
And while the last preparations is in progress I would like to present you a small screenshot of new tower defence facilities. Thank you for your support and stay tuned!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35894867/e581432889f13007ae4e42001b707e17d9f6c880.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update to version 0.3.1
notes.content:
Hello! I am glad to present you our first regular update with new improvements, bug fixes and some additional content. Live version now is 0.3.1
Change log:

Improvements and chages:
1. New minigame added: fly on rocket and gather bonuses :)
2. Added sound volume setting (separately of music setting)
3. UI small changes.

Bug fixes:
1. Upgrade buildings bug fixed.
2. Problems with some buidlings prices fixed.
3. Small visual bugs fixed.
4. Other small technical improvements.

Thank you and have a nice day! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35894867/e9e083bca2a12b3e7a5cd2e3c2b5e87f65c6b658.png[/img]

notes.title: Small Patch Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Decided to tell you more about bunch of recent small updates, which were caused by first impressions of players who already tried our Early Access version.
So here is a changelog:

1. Resources income was rebalanced: now electricity and gold mining work more effectively.
2. Some of the achievments was deleted. Soon they will be replaced by another.
3. Small bug fixes and technical improves.

Thank you and stay tuned - our first huge update is coming soon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35894867/f3542e452069e7f0a9aa96499732639b46047c75.gif[/img]

notes.title: Smile To Fly - Early Access is open!
notes.content:
And finally the time has come! 
I'm glad to announce that Smile To Fly is now available in Early Access!
I believe, that Early Access is something that gives every player an opportunity to participate in game development process from early stages and to bring awesome ideas into the game via discussions.
Please, let me know if you have any thoughts about current version of the game or about how it can look in the future. Feel free to create a topic in the Community Hub.

More information about future updates are coming soon, so stay in touch and have a wonderful day!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35894867/4f66acca58bcd5c09c03d794614c016cb60abbd6.gif[/img]

notes.title: Smile To Fly demo is now available!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We are glad to announce that demo of the Early Access version goes live!
Demo version is providing 15 minutes of gameplay without any restrictions.
Demo version will be updating every time when new version of the full game will be published.
Also, note that you can use your saved progress from demo-version in the full game experience when it's released.
Thank you and have a nice day!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35894867/4c0850a19a4e8e31644e8b8444789d4d984771f7.gif[/img]
